# learning-platform-core 0.1.0

These browser assets are vendored from `learning-platform-core` commit
`f484b2d545cb36b086723b6ec1dcfd135c5c1678` (`feat: initialise shared learning
platform core`). They are kept in a versioned directory so this static GitHub
Pages hub has no runtime dependency on GitHub or npm and can be rolled back
with its own reviewed commit.

The JavaScript and CSS files are unmodified build outputs. `LICENSE` is copied
from the same commit.

This matches the reviewed static integration used by the T Level Software
Development Hub.
